outcome: Anti-SARS-CoV-2 Spike IgG levels in serum and breast milk
Anti-SARS-CoV-2 Spike IgA levels in serum and breast milk
Antibody kinetics in serum and breast milk
Binding breadth of antibodies in breast milk
Neutralization capacity of antibodies in serum and breast milk
cohort: Thirteen lactating women were enrolled prior to receiving SARS-CoV-2 immunization to study their immune responses.
finding: Postpartum SARS-CoV-2 mRNA-LNP vaccination elicits robust IgG and moderate IgA responses in serum that are transferred to breast milk and persist for several months, with hybrid immune individuals demonstrating enhanced neutralization and anti-Spike IgG.
